# Aaliyah

Portfolio of Aaliyah, a third-year Information Science and Engineering student at Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences, Bengaluru.

## Projects

- SK Caterers and Events: admin system in daily use by a catering business (Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite).
- SpecForge: corrects university course specifications and re-derives the CO-PO-PSO map. Solo hackathon build.
- YUKTI: crime intelligence platform for Karnataka State Police. Team project, shortlisted at Hack2Skill Datathon 2026. Aaliyah built the database and AI model integration.
